## Working with the people who decide

The hubs work directly with **National Malaria Programmes** — including the National Malaria Control Programme (NMCP) in Tanzania — so that models answer the questions decision-makers actually face. The network is reinforced by a regional **Community of Practice** in vector epidemiology and modelling, connecting modellers, researchers and decision-makers across the three countries as the project grows.
